content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient presenting with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat (R00.2), which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Continuous rhythm monitoring during daily activities was medically necessary to correlate the patient's symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities. We request review of the medical necessity of this diagnostic service; the authorization was not obtained prior to the service, and we ask that the CO-197 denial be reconsidered based on the submitted clinical documentation."}
